description: Real USGS ComCat catalog excerpt: California-region M>=2.5 earthquakes, 2019-06-01 <= time < 2019-08-01 (contains the 2019 Ridgecrest M6.4 of July 4 and M7.1 of July 6). Untouched rows from the upstream CSV; only columns were reduced to time/latitude/longitude/depth/mag and rows outside the two-month window dropped. No values were edited.
